verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV documents webhook events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) that let developers subscribe for real-time updates instead of polling, matching the core 'react to lifecycle without polling' need. However, the evidence never shows the specific status names in the story (created/processing/verified/requires-input) nor confirms webhook payloads are cryptographically signed/verifiable. Missing for 10: documented signed-webhook verification mechanism, explicit mapping of STATUS_UPDATED values to the named lifecycle states, and independent confirmation of reliability.
